items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And we went to Omaha, Nebraska, where I joined this band called Warren Webb

ctx.x: bands in those days. His name was Warren Webb. And he needed a piano player, so they waited for me until the next day, because I couldn't convince my father that I should go out again. But he let me be my own man, and he tried to discourage me. He wanted me to go to college, but he knew that I was going so he finally just -- I went off with this band.
And we went to Omaha, Nebraska, where I joined this band called Warren Webb, and these are some of the questions that I think that you're interested in.

Yes, I am. Yes, I am. Well, in staying with that band you began to be able to cope with reading the music, for instance, or your reading was improving that much, was it? Or had it already improved that much?
